hero.title: Pricing and passes
hero.text: Join high-energy Zumba sessions in Paris designed to keep you moving, sweating, and smiling. Choose between single drop-in passes or flexible monthly packages, and enjoy complete transparency with no hidden fees.

intro.title: Class rates and policies
intro.text: Book online via PayPal, pay on our website, or pay cash directly at the door before session start. Your first class is 100% free when you subscribe to our mailing list.

cta.title: Ready to dance with us?
cta.text: Sign up for our newsletter to claim your free first class or reserve your spot today. Discover our full weekly timetable and see what to expect in every session.
